assets.title: Inbox Clear
assets.prompt:
Create ONE original routine poster for Azora, a warm, calm, grown-up home and routine app. Portrait image EXACTLY 1024x1536 pixels, 2:3. Editorial craftsmanship and variety, NOT children's art, app icons, clay toys, or a mobile interface. Palette: warm cream #FDF6F0, deep navy, sky blue, teal, amber, violet, coral and blush. Keep important text and complete objects within x=75..949 and y=105..1425 (at least 6% inside all edges). Only decorative corner shapes may crop off the edges. Title bold and medium-large, using at most 25% of the total image height. All non-checklist titles use the same clean contemporary bold sans-serif family; labels use a neat clear sans-serif, approximately 46-50px, legible at 188pt poster width. Objects small to medium with clear space around each. Add restrained finishing details: cropped corner shapes, thin dividers, tiny sparkles or paper grain appropriate to the style. Original artwork, no logos, app UI, phone frames, watermark, signature or extra words. Every text string must be perfectly spelled and rendered verbatim with exact capitalization and punctuation. Objects such as books, phones, notes and calendars must be unlettered; the supplied text is the ONLY permitted writing.
STYLE N: Editorial notebook collage: pale grid paper lightly tinted with the main colour, a textured torn-paper note containing the title, a few tiny hearts or sparkles, one medium-large realistic glossy still-life object overlapping the TOP EDGE OF THE NOTE, safely within the canvas. In the lower portion, small-to-medium realistic glossy 3D objects sit on delicate ruled lines with their exact small neat labels BELOW. Objects have adult product-photography realism, believable materials and controlled studio highlights, not clay or toys. Three labels use three spacious rows; four labels use a 2x2 layout. Pale colours, tidy hierarchy and abundant breathing room.
Main colour: sky.
Exact title: "Inbox Clear". Break over 2 or 3 lines as needed without changing words or hyphens.
Hero still life: three cream envelopes in a slim sky-blue letter tray.
Exact labels, in order: ["Urgent","Archive","Follow-Ups"]. Illustrate one distinct recognisable object or small still life corresponding to each label. Do not repeat or add labels.
assets.revisionPrompt: Make ONE targeted addition to this poster, preserving everything else exactly: add a small realistic glossy sky-blue letter tray holding three blank cream envelopes, overlapping the TOP EDGE of the torn-paper title note. The added tray should be approximately300px wide and170px tall, centred horizontally, with its top at y=110 and bottom at y=280. It must not cover any title letters. This restores the notebook layout hero. Keep title "Inbox Clear" and the existing three object rows and exact labels "Urgent", "Archive", "Follow-Ups" completely unchanged. Keep grid, paper, colour, margins, typography and negative space unchanged. No extra words anywhere. Output1024x1536.
assets.textReview: Manually read every title and label in final revision; checked exact supplied wording.
